steps.setup: Keep the successful enclosure or safely managed long-line setup. Select either a slightly longer clear approach or a mild ordinary sniffing opportunity, with the other feature easy and no road, wildlife or frightening trigger nearby.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

MATCTX.title: Mat comfort in another place
MATCTX.previousSharedSetup: Start with a quiet room, not a busy cafe or trigger-filled park.
MATCTX.sharedSetupReview: Quiet-location advice is appropriate; prepare the familiar mat and later resting arrangement rather than repeating the cue objective.

steps.setup: Lay the familiar mat on a non-slip floor in another quiet room. Start beside it with rewards ready and space for an easy approach and exit, without a long stay planned.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Place the familiar mat in the successful new quiet spot and sit nearby with quiet rewards. Keep an open exit; prepare only a small ordinary household movement if the restful interval is already comfortable.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

WALKCTX.title: Loose walking in another place
WALKCTX.previousSharedSetup: Secure comfortable equipment; broad paths and exits.
WALKCTX.sharedSetupReview: Equipment and exits are suitable; specify an easy adjacent location and a single planned variation.

steps.setup: Choose a quiet nearby place such as the yard edge, with broad footing and a clear exit. Check comfortable secure equipment and rewards at your side; keep a sniff-break area available.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

KEEP.title: Maintain skills and review changes
KEEP.previousSharedSetup: Select a few useful skills; do not retest everything in one session.
KEEP.sharedSetupReview: Skill selection is planning rather than a complete setup; distinguish active refresher preparation from record review.

steps.setup: Select one familiar useful skill and an optional enjoyable activity. Prepare only their usual safe equipment in an easy setting, with rewards ready and enough time for a brief relaxed session.

BOW.title: Take a little bow
BOW.previousSharedSetup: Healthy comfortable movement on a non-slip floor. Capture a natural stretch; skip for pain, stiffness, or balance concerns.
BOW.sharedSetupReview: Healthy natural movement and no forced stretching remain essential; prepare observation versus prompted turns distinctly.

steps.setup: Choose an ordinary relaxed transition from rest on non-slip flooring. Keep a reward quietly accessible and enough space around your dog for a natural stretch; do not wake or provoke them.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Prepare a broad non-slip patch during a comfortable playful moment. Sit or stand where your empty hand can signal without touching the body, with rewards separate and room to stand again.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Use the same comfortable non-slip area and familiar empty-hand gesture. Have rewards ready and plan only a few brief turns; skip for stiffness, imbalance or reluctance rather than preparing a held stretch.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

MIDDLE.title: Stand between your legs
MIDDLE.previousSharedSetup: Only if the dog fits with generous clearance and the handler is steady; otherwise use a cone game.
MIDDLE.sharedSetupReview: Handler stability and body clearance are essential; define a straight exit and optional cones without squeezing the dog.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Use the familiar roomy stance with your feet still and a clear forward exit. Keep rewards accessible at natural forward head height; neither participant should need to balance awkwardly or close the gap.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

WEAVE.title: A slow figure eight
WEAVE.previousSharedSetup: Generous body clearance and a steady handler; wide curves only. Cone figure eights are an alternative.
WEAVE.sharedSetupReview: Clearance and steady feet are appropriate; prepare each broad loop before joining them.

steps.setup: Use a steady wide stance on non-slip footing with generous space around one leg. Have the familiar target hand and separate rewards ready; use a cone instead if body clearance is tight.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Clear an equally broad arc around the other leg, with your feet steady. Prepare the other empty target hand and accessible rewards without arranging a faster linked sequence yet.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Prepare both familiar broad loops on non-slip flooring, with ample exit space and still feet. Keep both target hands available and rewards accessible for a halfway reward if needed.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

NOSEBALL.title: Roll a ball with the nose
NOSEBALL.previousSharedSetup: A lightweight ball far too large to swallow; clear flat non-slip floor; no hard or tiny balls.
NOSEBALL.sharedSetupReview: Oversized lightweight ball and clear footing are essential; define stability and limited rolling space for each stage.

steps.setup: Choose a light smooth ball far too large to swallow and a clear non-slip area. Hold it still just below natural nose height, with rewards separate; avoid hard balls or small detachable parts.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

BOWL.title: Dog bowling

BOWL.sharedSetupReview: Quiet safe pins are appropriate; arrange the single close pin before a larger cluster.

steps.setup: Arrange two or three familiar soft quiet pins in a close wide cluster beyond a short straight ball lane. Check all pieces are too large to swallow and have rewards accessible for each reset.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

GOAL.title: Score a gentle goal
GOAL.previousSharedSetup: Two widely spaced soft markers and a known oversized ball; no nets or entanglement hazards.
GOAL.sharedSetupReview: Soft wide markers and no net are essential; keep the goal close while changing only the cue or starting spot.

HIGHFIVE.title: Low high five
HIGHFIVE.previousSharedSetup: A stable comfortable position; hand kept below the dog’s elbow, with no paw pulling.
HIGHFIVE.sharedSetupReview: Low hand height and no paw pulling are appropriate; specify stable footing and a brief release route.

WAVE.title: A little wave

POSE.title: A comfortable photo pose

POSE.sharedSetupReview: Comfortable posture, quiet camera and no flash are essential; distinguish camera presence from taking a photo.

TOYNAME.title: Give one toy a name

TWOOBJECT.title: An optional two-toy choice
TWOOBJECT.previousSharedSetup: Two safe familiar toys with distinct labels; neutral body position; optional helper to place objects.

CARDS.title: Respond to picture cue cards

CROSSPAW.title: Rest with crossed front paws

CROSSPAW.sharedSetupReview: Joint comfort and no held crossing are essential; position a low target without asking for a stretched or trapped limb.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

TILT.title: A little head tilt

TILT.sharedSetupReview: Natural capture and no startling sounds are essential; setup should not manufacture the target movement.

SHAKEOFF.title: Shake off on cue
SHAKEOFF.previousSharedSetup: Capture ordinary comfortable shakes only. Do not use stress, water sprays, restraint or irritating objects to produce them.
SHAKEOFF.sharedSetupReview: Natural opportunities and no aversive prompts are essential; prepare observation rather than provoking a shake.

CIRCLEME.title: Circle around the handler
CIRCLEME.previousSharedSetup: Open non-slip space and a steady standing or seated handler; generous clearance, no moving feet or tight curves.
CIRCLEME.sharedSetupReview: Steady handler and broad curves are suitable; clear the full route before linking half-loops.

UNROLL.title: Unroll a short mat

UNROLL.sharedSetupReview: Low resistance, no hidden food and no chewing are essential; prepare a very loose initial roll and the later smaller target separately.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

LEFTRIGHT.title: Choose left or right targets

LEFTRIGHT.sharedSetupReview: Two-target setup is premature for independent pairings; define orientation, one side at a time, then a fair two-side choice.

steps.setup: Place two identical broad flat targets at equal short distances either side of the usual forward-facing start. Stand centered with neutral hands and gaze, rewards hidden and a simple response record ready.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

NOD.title: A small nose-target nod
NOD.previousSharedSetup: A broad safe target, natural neck range and brief turns. No repeated bobbing, head pressure or exaggerated flexion.
NOD.sharedSetupReview: Natural neck range and safe target are essential; limit the prepared positions rather than prescribing exaggerated flexion.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Use the familiar target and the same tiny lower-to-neutral range. Keep rewards accessible and plan one or two brief turns, with no head pressure or equipment that could restrict movement. Skip for neck stiffness.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

POINT.title: Follow a pointing gesture
POINT.previousSharedSetup: Two identical broad flat targets in a quiet space. Handler points without leaning over or crowding; this is learned cue-following rather than a claim about reasoning.
POINT.sharedSetupReview: Two identical mats suit choice work but not the first single-target pairing; prepare visible arm space and neutral starts.

steps.setup: Place one familiar broad flat mat a step away in a quiet room. Stand where your arm gesture is comfortably visible without leaning over the dog, with rewards separate and a clear approach.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Place two identical flat mats equally near on non-slip flooring. Prepare a central starting position, still feet and neutral gaze, with rewards accessible and space for one clear pointing gesture.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

BACK.title: Back up a few steps
BACK.previousSharedSetup: Flat non-slip space with an unobstructed route; no narrow chute, leash pressure, or approach into the dog.
BACK.sharedSetupReview: Open non-slip space is appropriate; ensure the growing backward route remains free without pressure or a chute.

steps.setup: Choose an open non-slip patch with clear space behind your comfortably standing dog. Stand still without crowding them and keep rewards ready at natural head height; no wall, narrow chute or lead pressure is needed.

steps.setup: Use the same level open area with at least one comfortable footstep of clear space behind the dog. Keep your own feet still and rewards accessible without leaning into their route.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

CONE.title: Go around a cone
CONE.previousSharedSetup: A stable soft cone or broad safe object; clear non-slip space.
CONE.sharedSetupReview: Stable safe marker is suitable; prepare a broad walking arc and reset space rather than a tight turn.

steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.

steps.setup: Use the same nearby stable cone and roomy loop, with no obstacles at the finish. Keep your guiding hand empty and rewards ready for an easy halfway delivery if needed.
steps.decision: Use this step-specific preparation instead of the shared objective/setup block.
